description: The bar chart, titled "QA-2," compares the performance of two models—EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 and RedWhale (our)—on a financial question-answering task. The horizontal bars represent the percentage of correct, partially correct, and incorrect responses, with the total for each model summing to 100%. For EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, the performance is broken down into 92.9% correct (dark purple), 2.9% partially correct (medium blue), and 4.3% incorrect (light blue). In contrast, RedWhale (our) achieves a higher correct rate of 95.7%, with 1.4% partially correct and 2.9% incorrect. The legend at the bottom clarifies the color coding: dark purple for "Correct," medium blue for "Partially Correct," and light blue for "Incorrect." The chart visually demonstrates that RedWhale outperforms the EEVE-Korean model, particularly in the "Correct" category, while also showing a lower rate of incorrect answers.
